Cross-validation of a selection path

Source: R/select_cv.R
cv.Rd

Chooses the penalty of a var_select() path by K-fold cross-validation of the binomial deviance (for a survival outcome, the partial-likelihood deviance per event of the held-out rows within their own strata and risk sets for the Cox model, the binomial deviance per person-period for the discrete-time model). Folds are formed within every provider over its patients (rows when there is no patient column), so that each provider is present in every training set whenever it has at least two units; a provider held out entirely is predicted with the median provider effect of the training fit.

Usage

cv(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'pp_lasso'
cv(object, n_folds = 10, folds = NULL, seed = NULL, ...)

Arguments

object

a path from var_select(); every fold refits it with the same settings and penalties.

...

unused.

n_folds

number of folds. Default 10.

folds

optional fold membership (integers from 1) of the rows of data$data; rows of excluded providers are ignored.

seed

optional seed for the fold assignment; the random-number state of the session is restored afterwards.

Value

An object of class pp_cv:

lambda

the penalty sequence of the full-data path.

cve, cvse

the cross-validated deviance per row, event or person-period (mean over folds of the fold means) and its standard error across folds.

lambda_min, lambda_1se

the penalty with the smallest cve and the largest penalty whose cve is within one standard error of it.

selected_min, selected_1se

the covariates selected at those penalties.

fit

the path on the full data.

folds

the fold of each row of the fitted data.

Examples

# \donttest{
d <- sim_kecc(n_providers = 20, n_covariates = 6, seed = 1)
pd <- pp_data(d, y = "y", x = paste0("x", 1:6), provider = "provider",
              patient = "patient", message = FALSE)
cvp <- cv(var_select(pd, n_lambda = 20), n_folds = 5, seed = 1)
cvp
#> Cross-validated lasso path (5 folds)
#>   lambda_min 0.001232: 6 covariates selected (x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6)
#>   lambda_1se 0.02258: 6 covariates selected
cvp$selected_min
#> [1] "x1" "x2" "x3" "x4" "x5" "x6"
# }
